name: What Comes Next

angles.text: This expedition establishes direct travel to Mulgore to connect with the Earthen Ring, the revered shamanic organization dedicated to soothing the elemental spirits of Azeroth.
The destination across the skies is Mulgore, the ancestral homeland of the tauren people where the Earthen Ring maintains their operations.

faq.answer: What Comes Next is a transition quest marking the departure from Zephras Isle. After earning the blessing of High Elder Shadowsong and ensuring the cult has been handled, travelers prepare to embark via skycutter to mainland Kalimdor.
faq.q: What is the quest What Comes Next?

faq.answer: The skycutter voyage connects Zephras Isle with Mulgore, a grassy mesa region in central Kalimdor where the Earthen Ring makes their home and where advance members of the expedition are already waiting.

Ayessa Dawnsinger is the coordinator overseeing the departure from Zephras Isle. She confirms that preparations are in place, test flights have succeeded, and the expedition has High Elder Shadowsong's blessing to set out.
Muln is an ally who worked diligently to establish stable skycutter transport between Zephras Isle and Mulgore, conducting test voyages to ensure safe passage across the skies.

The Earthen Ring is an organization of shaman dedicated to maintaining harmony among the elemental spirits. In this expedition, they serve as the contact and hosts welcoming travelers arriving in Mulgore.
With the local cult defeated and High Elder Shadowsong's blessing secured, the purpose of remaining isolated on Zephras Isle is fulfilled, allowing the expedition to expand onward to the mainland.
faq.q: Why is the expedition leaving Zephras Isle?

sections.body: With the local cult defeated and safety restored to Zephras Isle, High Elder Shadowsong has granted blessing for an onward journey. The island's expedition now looks beyond its shores, turning its focus across the open skies toward the continent of Kalimdor. Ayessa Dawnsinger coordinates the final departure for those ready to leave the island behind.
sections.title: Departure from Zephras Isle

sections.body: Establishing transport off the island required steady preparation. Muln worked diligently to secure stable skycutter travel between Zephras Isle and Mulgore. Following successful test voyages, an advance party has already crossed over to wait on the other side, preparing to make contact with the shaman of the Earthen Ring.
sections.title: Skycutters to Mulgore

summary: What Comes Next marks the culmination of affairs on Zephras Isle as travelers prepare to depart across the skies. With the local cult threat quelled and High Elder Shadowsong's blessing secured, skycutter transport is opened between the island and the plains of Mulgore.
